qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Understandability / Outside Verifiability, REJECT). Long-tail Life & Health reinsurance assumptions and casualty reserving are opaque and unverifiable from the outside. In 2024, unexpected negative experience variances forced severe actuarial assumption revisions, wiping out group net income to €4M and requiring external actuarial firms (Milliman, WTW) to audit book values.
qualitative.evidence: SCOR incurred ~€0.7B in pre-tax insurance service result hits and a ~€1.3B CSM downward adjustment in 2024 due to legacy life reinsurance assumption revisions. Chronic reserve volatility and reliance on complex biometric/mortality actuarial estimates violate Gate 1 external verifiability.
